info.name: zombie-service
info.description:
Every endpoint of zombie-service.

Set `serviceToken` and `playerToken` first:

    docker compose exec zombie-service bundle exec rake token:service
    docker compose exec zombie-service bundle exec rake token:player

Run the folders top to bottom with the Collection Runner. Requests capture `zombieId` and `disposableZombieId` into collection variables, so later requests reuse them. `event_id` uses {{$guid}}, so re-running never replays an old idempotency record.

Every endpoint here is marked `Bearer <service_jwt>` in the contract, so the player token is only used to prove it is rejected.

exec: pm.test(".error is \"Missing or invalid Authorization header.\"", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("Missing or invalid Authorization header."));
pm.test(".error is \"Invalid or expired service token.\"", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("Invalid or expired service token."));

item.name: Create a type with missing fields

exec: pm.test(".error is \"Zombie type not found.\"", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("Zombie type not found."));

item.name: Delete a type that still has instances

exec: pm.test(".error is \"Cannot delete a zombie type that still has active instances.\"", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("Cannot delete a zombie type that still has active instances."));
pm.test(".error is \"Zombie type not found.\"", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("Zombie type not found."));
pm.test(".error is \"Zombie instance not found.\"", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("Zombie instance not found."));

item.name: Move a zombie to another room

exec: pm.test(".error is \"Zombie instance not found or already despawned.\"", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("Zombie instance not found or already despawned."));

item.name: Get state for an unknown zombie

exec: pm.test(".error is \"Zombie instance not found.\"", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("Zombie instance not found."));

item.name: Remove more than the zombie holds

exec: pm.test(".error is \"Insufficient items to remove from zombie inventory.\"", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("Insufficient items to remove from zombie inventory."));
pm.test("the loot is held by the zombie", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().inventory).to.deep.include({ item_id: "wood-01", count: 2 }));
pm.test("the coffee is held by the zombie", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().inventory).to.deep.include({ item_id: "coffee-01", count: 1 }));

item.name: Kill it again with a fresh event_id

exec: pm.test(".error is \"Zombie instance not found or already despawned.\"", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("Zombie instance not found or already despawned."));
